title: Send the Guard Away
setup: Black's knight on d6 covers both c8 and e8, and your rook already sits on the seventh rank.
hint: One black piece is holding two squares. Attack the one you do not actually want.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qc8+}} is not the mating square — it is the decoy. Both knight moves lose, and {{Nxc8}} at least takes something and the knight abandons e8, so {{Re8#}} lands. Offer the defender the duty it can perform, and it will fail the one it cannot.
